title: Massive Molecular Gas Flows in the A1664 Brightest Cluster Galaxy
question: What are the mass, kinematics and origin (inflow, outflow or merger) of the molecular gas in the Abell 1664 BCG?

data.sensitivity: rms 0.5 mJy (40 km/s chan) CO(1-0); 1.5 mJy (30 km/s chan) CO(3-2)

evidence.quote: determine a star formation rate of $\sim20\hbox{$\hbox{$\rm\thinspace M_{\odot}$}\rm\; yr^{-1}\,$}$
the infrared star formation rate, $SFR_{\rm IR}=15\hbox{$\hbox{$\rm\thinspace M_{\odot}$}\rm\; yr^{-1}\,$}$ ((cite: ODea08))

recipe.goal: Calibrate and image cubes and continuum
recipe.method: CASA calibration with ALMA scripts; CLEAN cubes of continuum-subtracted data, Briggs robust 0.5, polygon masks; continuum from line-free channels

recipe.goal: Extract spectra and fit line components
recipe.method: Spectra from 6x6 arcsec (CO1-0) and 3x3 arcsec (CO3-2) regions fitted with two Gaussians

recipe.goal: Make moment maps and PV diagrams
recipe.method: Integrated intensity maps over velocity ranges; PV cuts along PA 77 deg (systemic) and 120 deg (HVS), PA from 2D Gaussian fit
M_mol = 1.05e4 X_CO /(1+z) S_CO dv D_L^2 from CO(1-0) intensities
assumptions: Galactic X_CO = 2e20 cm-2 (K km/s)-1; z=0.128; H0=70, Om=0.3, OL=0.7

recipe.goal: Assess origin (merger, inflow, outflow) via energetics and Toomre Q
recipe.method: Compare outflow energy with radiation pressure, supernova and AGN mechanical power; Toomre Q for putative disk

evidence.quote: The total CO mass in the BCG is then $(1.1\pm0.1)\times 10^{10}
The total CO(1-0) integrated intensity of $3.2\pm0.4

not_stated_but_needed: Line-free channels and continuum subtraction method/order
Image size, cell size, clean threshold and iterations
Spectral extraction details and baseline fitting
Pixel/region definitions for clumps A, B and HVS sub-regions
missing_for_reproduction: Image and cell sizes, clean threshold
score_reason: Simple recipe, public Cycle 0 data, but imaging and extraction details are sparse.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, simple recipe, numeric Gaussian-fit and mass results.
